instructions: Review the exact invented inputs and expectations before execution, without runtime outputs. Ten exposed writable development sources, ten fresh writable held-out sources, and one read-only case per split. English knowledge, independent English/Russian query and answer languages, explicit/inferred views. Commitments concern embedded propositions, not certainty that discussion occurred. self_attested is direct user provenance, not proof or an extra wording obligation. Preserve coupled contrasts, source attribution, uncertainty, fiction, conditional and lifecycle scope. Full retention preserves relevant source propositions; a focused answer may select an entailed subset without losing a material qualification. Explicit rejected-offer wording does not require redundant no-plan phrasing. Service provision does not establish booking. Source entailment is scored separately from qualification and language; each saved proposition and nonnull answer must follow from original source in content and scope. All-null or empty outcomes cannot count useful; unsupported accepted sets/answers must be zero. The useful-answer gate remains 90% in every split/run with two runs and eight combinations per case.
